system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 19. 3 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (38 seconds, code score 0.73) ---
[b00] INFORMANT (whispering, alarmed): "But they have separated her from the household. She is watched constantly. Every letter she sends is checked. Every visitor is questioned."
[b01] INFORMANT: "There are almost no loyal servants left around her."
[b02] INFORMANT (grave): "The people who served your family for years have been dismissed, frightened away, or replaced."
[b03] ACTION: Alexander lifts his gaze toward the cold forest canopy, his breathing heavy with profound anguish.
[b04] ALEXANDER (cold, pained fury): "My mother is a prisoner in her own house."
[b05] INFORMANT (quiet, solemn): "And everyone believes you are dead."
[b06] ALEXANDER (lethal, calculating): "Then let them believe it a little longer."
[b07] INFORMANT (inquiring, tense): "And when we have the proof?"
[b08] ALEXANDER (vow of vengeance, resolute): "Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to."
[b09] ACTION: The heavy wooden barn doors creak open. Alexander steps into the lantern light, carrying a bundle of firewood and a thick blanket under his arm.
[b10] JULIANA: "We have lost everything."
[b11] JULIANA (despairing, broken): "I don't know what we will do tomorrow."

--- WINDOW 1 (26 seconds, code score 0.72) ---
[b00] ACTION: A bald, scarred man dressed in a dark coat emerges from between the trees, immediately coming to a halt and bowing with clasped hands in formal deference.
[b01] INFORMANT (subservient, urgent): "Your Grace."
[b02] ALEXANDER (authoritative, direct): "Tell me what is happening in Ashburg."
[b03] INFORMANT (grave, cautious): "Lord Sterling's influence has grown since your disappearance. He has men in the county offices, the courts, even among the household staff."
[b04] INFORMANT: "Rupert has become the face of Ashburg. He sits in your father's room, signs your estate papers, gives orders as though the title already belongs to him."
[b05] INFORMANT (earnest): "And Lady Catherine, she behaves as though she is already the future duchess."
[b06] INFORMANT (whispering, alarmed): "But they have separated her from the household. She is watched constantly. Every letter she sends is checked. Every visitor is questioned."

--- WINDOW 2 (32 seconds, code score 0.64) ---
[b00] JULIANA (emotional, fragile): "My mother's book almost burned with it."
[b01] ACTION: Juliana tenderly lifts a scorched corner of parchment, revealing the surviving botanical drawing of medicinal herbs inside.
[b02] ELDER VILLAGER (respectful, sincere): "My lady. You cannot stay here."
[b03] ELDER VILLAGER: "There is an old barn near the village. It is empty."
[b04] ACTION: The elder villager steps closer, resting a gentle, reassuring hand on Juliana's shoulder.
[b05] ELDER VILLAGER (gentle, earnest): "Take it."
[b06] JULIANA (hesitant, humble): "We cannot ask the village to feed us."
[b07] ELDER VILLAGER (warm, grateful): "You saved my son's life."
[b08] ELDER VILLAGER: "You saved mine, too."
[b09] JULIANA (whispering, tearful): "Thank you."
[b10] ACTION: Alexander steps forward and accepts the thick folded blankets and a wooden bucket from the villager.
[b11] ALEXANDER (deep, solemn): "We will not forget this kindness."
[b12] ELDER VILLAGER (nodding, earnest): "Neither will the village."
[b13] JULIANA (choked up, mournful): "Goodbye, Blackwood."

Pick the single best promo.
